knowledge:
- key_parameters: cpg.pval=A named numeric vector of p-values for each CpG, where names correspond to CpG IDs ;; array.type=Specifies the array platform, either "450K" (default) or "EPIC" (ignored if FullAnnot is provided) ;; FullAnnot=Preprocessed mapping between CpG IDs and gene names generated by prepareAnnot ;; group=Specifies the genomic region of CpGs to consider ("all", "body", "promoter1", "promoter2") ;; GS.list=A user-supplied list of gene sets where names are gene set IDs and elements are vectors of gene IDs ;; GS.idtype=The gene ID type in GS.list ("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL", "ENTREZID", "REFSEQ") ;; GS.type=The database to use if GS.list is empty ("GO", "KEGG", "Reactome") ;; minsize/maxsize=Integers defining the minimum and maximum gene set sizes to test ;; method=In methylRRA, specifies the test method, either "ORA" (default) or "GSEA" ;; sig.cut=In methylgometh, the p-value cutoff to declare a CpG as differentially methylated (default 0.001) ;; parallel=In methylglm, logical indicating whether to use parallel processing (default FALSE)
- alternatives: missMethyl (via gometh/gsameth)=Used internally by methylgometh for weighted resampling and Wallenius non-central hypergeometric approximation ;; GOglm=An RNA-Seq length bias correction method that inspired the logistic regression approach in methylglm
- when_to_use: Use when performing gene set enrichment or over-representation analysis on Illumina 450K or EPIC DNA methylation array data, or custom CpG-to-gene mappings, to eliminate the severe bias caused by genes with larger numbers of CpG probes.
- pitfalls: Forgetting to load the appropriate annotation package (IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19 for 450K or IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19 for EPIC) before running the analysis ;; If no CpGs or genes are significant under default FDR/p-value cutoffs in methylRRA or methylgometh, the analysis will fail or return empty results unless sig.cut is increased or the topDE option is used ;; When using custom CpG-to-gene mappings, the mapping must be preprocessed using prepareAnnot before passing it to the main functions.

workflows.name: methylglm_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform gene set analysis using a logistic regression model that incorporates the number of CpGs per gene as a covariate.
input: cpg.pval (named numeric vector of CpG p-values from differential methylation analysis)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the package and array annotation ;; 2. Run logistic regression-based gene set testing using methylglm ;; 3. Visualize the enrichment results using a bar plot.
workflows.code:
library(methylGSA)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
data(cpgtoy)
res1 = methylglm(cpg.pval = cpg.pval, minsize = 200, 
                 maxsize = 500, GS.type = "KEGG")
library(BiocParallel)
res_p = methylglm(cpg.pval = cpg.pval, minsize = 200,
                  maxsize = 500, GS.type = "KEGG", parallel = TRUE)
barplot(res1, num = 8, colorby = "pvalue")

workflows.name: methylrra_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform gene set analysis using Robust Rank Aggregation (RRA) to adjust for multiple CpG p-values per gene, followed by either ORA or GSEA.
input: cpg.pval (named numeric vector of CpG p-values from differential methylation analysis)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the package and array annotation ;; 2. Run RRA with Over-Representation Analysis (ORA) ;; 3. Run RRA with Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA).
workflows.code:
library(methylGSA)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
data(cpgtoy)
res2 = methylRRA(cpg.pval = cpg.pval, method = "ORA",
                    minsize = 200, maxsize = 210)
res3 = methylRRA(cpg.pval = cpg.pval, method = "GSEA",
                    minsize = 200, maxsize = 210)

workflows.name: methylgometh_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform gene set analysis adjusting for CpG probe density using weighted resampling and Wallenius non-central hypergeometric approximation via missMethyl.
input: cpg.pval (named numeric vector of CpG p-values from differential methylation analysis)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the package and array annotation ;; 2. Run hypergeometric-based testing using methylgometh with a specified significance cutoff.
workflows.code:
library(methylGSA)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
data(cpgtoy)
res4 = methylgometh(cpg.pval = cpg.pval, sig.cut = 0.001,
                        minsize = 200, maxsize = 210)

workflows.name: custom_annotation_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform gene set analysis using a user-supplied CpG-to-gene mapping and custom gene sets.
input: cpg.pval (named numeric vector of CpG p-values)
CpG2Gene (data frame or matrix mapping CpG IDs to gene names)
GS.list (list of custom gene sets containing gene symbols)
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocess the custom CpG-to-gene mapping using prepareAnnot ;; 2. Run gene set testing using methylRRA with the custom annotation and custom gene sets.
workflows.code:
library(methylGSA)
data(cpgtoy)
data(GSlisttoy)
data(CpG2Genetoy)
FullAnnot = prepareAnnot(CpG2Gene) 
GS.list = GS.list[1:10]
res5 = methylRRA(cpg.pval = cpg.pval, FullAnnot = FullAnnot, method = "ORA", 
                    GS.list = GS.list, GS.idtype = "SYMBOL", 
                    minsize = 100, maxsize = 300)
